notebooks.title: 核对特征方程与特征向量

cells.code:
A = sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(3,4), sp.Rational(1,4)], [sp.Rational(1,4), sp.Rational(3,4)]])
lam = sp.symbols('lam')
v1, v2 = sp.Matrix([1, 1]), sp.Matrix([1, -1])
print("特征多项式:", sp.expand((A-lam*sp.eye(2)).det()))
print("因式分解:", sp.factor((A-lam*sp.eye(2)).det()))
print("两组残差:", list(A*v1-v1), list(A*v2-sp.Rational(1,2)*v2))
print("求解器结果:", A.eigenvects())

notebooks.title: 核对换坐标和多步公式

cells.code:
A = sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(3,4), sp.Rational(1,4)], [sp.Rational(1,4), sp.Rational(3,4)]])
P = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [1, -1]])
D = sp.diag(1, sp.Rational(1,2))
x0 = sp.Matrix([2, 0])
print("P的行列式/逆:", P.det(), P.inv().tolist())
print("新坐标:", list(P.inv()*x0))
print("换坐标后的矩阵:", (P.inv()*A*P).tolist())
print("重构残差:", (A-P*D*P.inv()).tolist())
for k in [0, 1, 2, 3, 8]:
    print("步数/直接乘/对角化:", k, list(A**k*x0), list(P*D**k*P.inv()*x0))

notebooks.title: 核对重根、缺方向与旋转

J = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [0, 1]])
R = sp.Matrix([[0, -1], [1, 0]])
print("单位阵特征空间维数:", len((sp.eye(2)-sp.eye(2)).nullspace()))
print("剪切特征值及基:", J.eigenvects())
for k in [0, 1, 3, 8]:
    print("剪切步数/状态:", k, list(J**k*sp.Matrix([0, 1])))
print("旋转特征值:", R.eigenvals())
print("旋转复向量残差:", list(R*sp.Matrix([1, -sp.I])-sp.I*sp.Matrix([1, -sp.I])))
print("四次旋转:", (R**4).tolist())

B = sp.diag(2, -1, 0)
print("题1:", [list(B*sp.eye(3)[:,i]) for i in range(3)])
H = sp.Matrix([[2, 1], [0, 3]])
P2, D2 = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [0, 1]]), sp.diag(2, 3)
print("题2特征值/基:", H.eigenvects())
print("题2残差/行列式:", (H*P2-P2*D2).tolist(), P2.det())
P = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [1, -1]])
A = P*sp.diag(1, sp.Rational(1,2))*P.inv()
print("题3坐标/两步/极限:", list(P.inv()*sp.Matrix([3,1])), list(A**2*sp.Matrix([3,1])), list(2*P[:,0]))
print("题4:", sp.eye(2).eigenvects())
J = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [0, 1]])
print("题5特征空间:", [list(v) for v in (J-sp.eye(2)).nullspace()])
print("题5两初值:", list(J**3*sp.Matrix([0,1])), list(J**3*sp.Matrix([1,0])))
C = P*sp.diag(sp.Rational(3,4), -sp.Rational(1,2))*P.inv()
print("题6前两步:", list(C*sp.Matrix([2,0])), list(C**2*sp.Matrix([2,0])))
G = P*sp.diag(sp.Rational(5,4), sp.Rational(1,2))*P.inv()
print("题6衰减/增长方向:", list(G*sp.Matrix([1,-1])), list(G*sp.Matrix([1,1])))
